IS : 12052 - 1988 



Indian Standard 



( Reaffirmed 1999) 



SPECIFICATION FOR 
FUEL INJECTION PUMP MOUNTING BOLTS 



1. Scope — Specifies general and dimensional requirements of spherical seating bolts for in-line, lug 
mounted, fuel injection pumps. 

2. Dimensions — Shall be as shown in Fig. 1. 



2.5 



V 



50 



012.7 



M8 



rt> 



KLJ 



13 



All dimensions in millimetres. 
FIG. 1 DIMENSIONS OF SPHERICAL SEATING BOLT 

2.1 Dimensional tolerances not specified shall be in accordance with IS : 1364 ( Part 1 )-1983 
'Specification for hexagon head bolts, screws and nuts of product grades A and B : Part 1 Hexagon 
head bolts { size range MS to M36 ) {second revision )'. 

3. IMechanical Properties — Shall be of property class 88 in accordance with IS : 1367 ( Part 3 )-1979 
'Technical supply conditions for threaded steel fasteners: Part 3 Mechanical properties and test 
methods for bolts, screws and studs with full loadability ( second revision )'. 

4. Manufacture — Bolts shall be quenched and tempered in accordance with the manufacturer's 
recommendation to achieve the property class of 8*8 [see IS : 1367 { Part 3)-1979]. 

5. Workmanship — Bolts shall be well formed and free from cracks, burrs, etc. 

6. Surface Treatment — Finished bolts shall be galvanized or phosphated. The hot dip galvanizing 
shall be in accordance with IS : 1367 ( Part 13)-1983 Technical supply conditions for threaded steel 
fasteners : Part 13 Hot dip galvanizing on threaded fasteners'. 

6,1 When phosphated. the coating shall be in accordance with IS : 1367 { Part 12)-1981 'Technical 
supplyj conditions for threaded steel fasteners; Part 12 Phosphate coatings on threaded fasteners 
{secoi^d revishn )'. 

7. Designation — Shall be, unless otherwise stated, as specified in IS : 1367 (Part 16)-1979 
Technical supply conditions for threaded steel fasteners : Part 16 Designation system and symbols 
{second revision )'. 

8. IMarking — Each bolt shall be marked with trade-mark or manufacturer's name, property class, etc. 
8.1 Standard Marliing — Details available with the Bureau of Indian Standards. 

9. Packing — Shall be in accordance with the best prevalent trade practice. 

10. Sampling — Shall be in accordance with IS : gj514-1969 'Methods for sampling of fasteners 
{first revision )\ 3

IS: 12352- 1988 

E X P L A N A TO R Y NOTE 

The mounting bolts piny an important part in the proper fixing of fuel injection pumps on the 
cylinder head of an engine. Bolts having 120" chamfer are also being used by the industry. However, 
for better alignment, bolts with spherical seating are preferred. In this standard, only spherical seating 
bolts are covered. Chamfered bolts wuuld be included after gaining sufficient experience in their use.
